snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 - Sister of Battle Extended Cut Trailer
snippet.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is coming to PC and consoles in 2026! Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115160/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun_2/

Pledge your allegiance to the Imperial faith and storm into combat as Sister
of Battle, Nyra Veyrath! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to purge!
